dataQuality.label: Data quality
dataQuality.demoWarning: This is DEMO data. The prices are synthetic — use it to see how the engine reasons, never to trade these levels.

actions.refreshHint: Read the charts again and redo the analysis. Candles already fetched are reused for up to a quarter of a bar, so a refresh within that window recomputes without spending another request.

refreshCost.pickerLabel: Choose which markets to refresh, and see what it costs first
refreshCost.title: Refresh which markets
refreshCost.subtitle: Only the metered feed costs anything. Untick a market you do not trade and you stop paying for it on every scan.
refreshCost.total: {{now}} credits now · {{full}} once the candles age
refreshCost.cachedNote: The candles on screen are still fresh, so this press re-runs the analysis without fetching anything. The second number is what the same press costs after they expire.
refreshCost.coldNote: The candles have aged out, so this press fetches new ones and spends the credits above.
refreshCost.overBudget: That is more than the minute has left. The markets that miss out fall back to the candles already fetched — real prices, but no longer current.

feed.partialHint: Their data did not arrive, so they were left out of the reading below. Whatever this screen says, it does not say anything about them.
feed.noneHint: No data arrived for any market, so nothing on this screen was measured. This is an empty screen, not a quiet market — do not read it as one.
feed.retryHint: Usually a passing network or rate-limit problem. Refresh in a moment.

disclaimer: This is an educational and analytical tool, not financial advice. You make the final decision on every trade.
